title: Cat Overlords Rule Here
description: A cat sitting on a keyboard outmaneuvers a desperate Omegle stranger with tuna-backed diplomacy and zero chill.

messages.Ava: my cat just sat on my keyboard
she’s the only one who gets privileges here
nah i don’t send pics of my cat or my face to omegle strangers
not even if you paid me in tuna and existential dread
